answer_2.quote: we evaluate on Level-2 relations in two scenarios: exact match, where the label, argument span, and relation type must match, and span-only match, meaning the relation type was identified and argument spans are correct but the label may not be.

answer_4.quote: Following an initial training session with joint adjudication, data was corrected by a team of nine Computational Linguistics graduate students and faculty with formal training in discourse parsing formalisms as part of a research project.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation includes correction of relations and argument spans based on manually corrected test data, with focus on sense prediction and connective naturalness.
